title: Gaza civil defence teams recover remains of 112 Palestinians from rubble
description:
Gaza will hold a mass funeral for the remains of 112 Palestinians, including 40 children, 38 women, and seven people with disabilities.

The remains were recovered from the rubble of homes destroyed by Israeli strikes on 23 November 2023, in the Sabra neighbourhood of Gaza City, according to Gaza’s civil defence.

The 112 remains were among the 308 people reported killed, with the recovery operation lasting 136 hours of digging, much of it by hand, under challenging conditions. The deceased are members of the Al-Hassayneh and Abu Sharia families.

Mohammed Abu Dan, who was in charge of the operation, reported that 157 bodies are still believed to remain under the rubble, with some remains having fused with concrete and rebar or being destroyed by the impact of the explosions.

The International Committee of the Red Cross said it supported the nearly two-week operation. Its Gaza spokesperson, Amani Al-Naouq, said thousands of families had spent more than two and a half years waiting to recover the remains of loved ones and described the search for missing people as a critical humanitarian issue.
